name: Thaumarotica
source:
Thaumarotica is a game about discovering the secret occult truths that underlies reality, and eventually becoming a weird sex wizard. It draws from real world mystic sexual practices and a bunch of movies, books, and fictional sources on the topic.

The protagonist starts out as a bit neurotic with some weird sexual hang-ups, and through the course of the game will find himself exposed to strange and deviant lifestyles both mundane and paranormal, and tempted by things he didn't even know existed. How quickly he succumbs depends on the choices you make - will he overcome his sexual neurosis or will they push him into strange new forms of depravity?

Eventually you'll have the opportunity to learn powerful magics to subvert and strengthen the desires of those around you - which will introduce an entirely new moral quandary.
translation:
《秘术情欲录》（Thaumarotica）是一部探索潜藏于现实表象之下的神秘学真相、并最终修行成为古怪“性爱巫师”的游戏。本作广泛汲取了现实世界中的神秘主义房中术传统，以及大量同题材电影、书籍与虚构作品的灵感。

主角起初只是个略显神经质、怀揣着些许古怪性心理症结的普通人；而随着游戏推进，他将接连接触到世俗与超自然领域中形形色色的离奇异端生活方式，并受到连自己此前都闻所未闻的事物诱惑。他沉沦的速度完全取决于你的选择——他究竟能克服自身的性心理症结，还是会被推向光怪陆离的全新堕落深渊？

最终，你还将有机会习得强大的秘法，肆意颠覆或强化身边之人的欲望——而这也将为你带来一场截然不同的全新道德困境。
